```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<blockquote><ul><li>item a<ul><li>sub a1</li></ul></li></ul></blockquote>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
